description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ProjectDaoTest' designed to test various functionalities of the 'ProjectDao' class within the OrangeHRM system's time management plugin. The tests cover methods related to project creation, retrieval, filtering, updating, deletion, and reporting, emphasizing interaction with project entities and data transfer objects in the system.

classes.name: ProjectDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the 'ProjectDao' functionalities in the OrangeHRM system, including project CRUD operations and reporting features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating 'ProjectDao' and populating test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testAddProject
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a new 'Project' entity.

methods.name: testGetProjects
methods.description: Tests retrieving projects based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByCustomerOrProjectName
methods.description: Tests filtering projects by customer name or project name.

methods.name: testFilterProjectByExcludeProjectIds
methods.description: Tests filtering out specific project IDs.

methods.name: testGetProjectById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a project by its ID.

methods.name: testIsProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a project name is already taken, considering project ID.

methods.name: testIsProjectAdmin
methods.description: Verifies if a user is a project admin.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdList
methods.description: Tests retrieving list of project IDs with consideration of deletion status.

methods.name: testGetProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Tests retrieving project IDs accessible by a project admin.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Tests generating project report criteria list and total hours for a project.

methods.name: testGetProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Tests counting report criteria list entries for a project report.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Checks which employees are accessible to a project admin.

methods.name: testGetProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaListAndTotalHours
methods.description: Tests detailed activity report list and total hours, filtered by activity and date.
